summary: Remove post_id from the BaseURL template-variable mechanism and from the manifest auth metadata.
reason: The generator promoted {post_id} from /api/v1/posts/{post_id} into the tenant-placeholder mechanism meant for values like Shopify's {shop}, so the CLI advertised a UNIPILE_POST_ID credential that does not exist and verify counted the missing env var as a critical auth failure. Every posts command already substitutes post_id from its positional argument.
validated_outcome: verify returned to 100% with 0 critical failures; posts get <id> still resolves from its positional.
